BHADARWAH CAMPUS
Department of Computer Science & IT
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
No: BC/JU/CS&IT/Adm/24/82
Dated: 23.07.2024
The eligible candidates are invited for walk-in-interview for the post of
Guest Lecturer in the Department of Computer Science & IT,
Bhaderwah Campus, University of Jammu. The appointment on the post
will be purely on temporary basis till further orders.
Interested eligible candidates should report at Office of the I/C Head,
Department of Computer Science & IT, Bhaderwah Campus for walk-in-
interview on 25th July 2024 at 11:00 AM with all relevant educational
documents and testimonials in original.
I/CHead
OfficeAddress:DepartmentofComputerScience&IT,BhaderwahCampus,UniversityofJammu
villageSungli Bhaderwah.Pin 182222,Mob: +91-9697436894, e-mail:sarwar.aabid@gmail.com
TERMS&CONDITIONS
1. The Guest Lecturer shall be eligible for remuneration as per the
University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits, which are
admissible to the regular employees of University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular
appointment in University of Jammu or for continued services in the
University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this engagement
any time in case of unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any
other administrative reasons/ compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute/ambiguity that may occur in the process of
selection, the decision of the University shall be final.
6. Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-In-
Interview on prescribed date and time along with all supporting
documents in original.
I/CHead
